title: Collect outcomes of parallel jobs
summary: A dashboard starts several independent jobs at once. It needs a complete report even when some jobs fail, with each outcome attached to its original position. Run a set of deterministic simulated asynchronous jobs and return every outcome in input order.
requirements: Each job is { id, outcome, value?, message? }, where outcome is "success" or "failure".
Convert each job into a Promise: success resolves with its value; failure rejects with Error(message).
Launch all Promises without awaiting them one by one; use Promise.allSettled.
Return an array of { id, status: "fulfilled", value } or { id, status: "rejected", reason: string }.
The output order must match the input order.
Inputs are valid; a successful job always has a JSON-compatible value and a failed job has a message string.
hints: Map the input jobs to Promises without waiting inside the map.
Use Promise.allSettled to collect both fulfillment and rejection.
Match each settled result with its original job index and normalize the reason message.
